resumeText:
Mohammed Irfan | Hyderabad | mohammed.irfan@example.com

SUMMARY
Hotel housekeeping supervisor with 8 years in guest rooms, public areas and the linen room.

EXPERIENCE
Housekeeping Supervisor, Charminar Heights Hotel, Hyderabad (2022 - present)
- Inspect 60 to 70 guest rooms per shift against the brand room inspection checklist before release.
- Run the linen room par stock and the monthly linen inventory with the laundry vendor.
- Supervise public area cleaning of the lobby, banquet halls and restrooms.
- Log guest lost and found items in the register and return them against ID.
- Update room status and discrepancy reports in the Opera housekeeping module.
- Prepare the weekly duty roster and room allocation for 22 room attendants.
- Led a team of 22 room attendants and housemen across morning and evening shifts.

Room Attendant, later Floor Supervisor, Golconda Residency, Hyderabad (2018 - 2022)
- Cleaned and set up 14 guest rooms a shift to hotel standards.
- Checked minibar and amenity replenishment on two floors.

SKILLS
Room inspection, Linen control, MS Excel

EDUCATION
Diploma in Hotel Operations, Hyderabad (2018)
